meta.objective: Define the implementation agenda for the current judge-gym work session before V4 matrix specification: simplify and generalize the evidence pipeline around ingest->views->analysis, identify legacy schema/runtime surfaces to prune, add provider-tier policy support including Anthropic tier handling, define the remaining experiment/config work required for literature-compatibility and regime checks, and produce a validated deep-workflow artifact plus synthesis deliverables that can drive the next coding phase with commit discipline in a dirty worktree.

decisions.title: Treat this turn as a pre-matrix readiness compile, not matrix design
decisions.rationale: The remaining blockers are evidence curation, experiment contracts, parser/output flexibility, provider-tier policy, and legacy-surface pruning.

decisions.title: Evidence should collapse toward ingest -> evidence sets -> views -> analysis
decisions.rationale: The V4 objective needs direct imports, curated high-quality pools, and reusable rendered views more than separate legacy window-era indirection.

decisions.title: Provider-tier support must become generic across providers
decisions.rationale: Current engine-settings model OpenAI tiers explicitly but Anthropic and OpenRouter only as raw overrides, which is insufficient for V4 runtime policy.

decisions.title: Commit in validated slices while excluding unrelated campaign deletions
decisions.rationale: The worktree is already dirty with non-V4 deletions, so commit boundaries must be explicit.
